journey.name: Two-pane layout: list and chat side by side on a tablet
journey.description: On an expanded window the chat list and the chat share the screen, the open chat is highlighted in the list, and the chat pane has no back arrow because there is nothing to go back to.

actions.action: Type "Reply with exactly: Hello" into the message field and tap send
Wait until a reply bubble appears containing "Hello"
Verify the chat list and the chat are both visible at the same time
Verify the open chat's item in the list is highlighted
Verify no back arrow is displayed in the chat pane's top bar
